trace.notes: The zbMATH record identified the exact work as Bugajski, 'Open problems', Soft Computing 5(2), page 140 (2001), and exposed DOI 10.1007/s005000100097. The DOI resolved to a Springer landing page that was readable only as bibliographic/paywalled preview metadata in this run, so no exact full-text PDF or HTML body containing the problem statements was available for extraction.

Failed the source adequacy gate because the available material consisted only of resolver metadata and a restricted landing page rather than the exact article text. Per contract, no open problems were accepted from title-only or preview-only evidence.
